formal_statement: ∃ (x1 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x2 : Fin (43 : ℕ)) (x3 : Fin (43 : ℕ)) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   (x1 = (1 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = (21 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = (22 : Fin (42 : ℕ))) ∧     x2 < x3 ∧       (x2, x3) ≠ ((0 : Fin (43 : ℕ)), x1.castSucc) ∧         (x3 = Fin.last (42 : ℕ) → x2 ≠ (0 : Fin (43 : ℕ)) ∧ x2 ≠ x1.castSucc) ∧           (∀ (x5 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), List.count ↑x5 [(0 : ℕ), ↑x1, ↑x2, ↑x3] = (1 : ℕ) → ∃ x7 ∈ x4.gates, ↑x5 ∈ x7.inputs) ∧             PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 ∧               PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (44 : ℕ) x4 ∧                 x4.size ≤ (122 : ℕ) ∧                   ∀ (x5 : Fin (42 : ℕ) → Bool),                     have x6 : Fin (43 : ℕ) → Bool := fun (x6 : Fin ((42 : ℕ) + (1 : ℕ))) => Fin.lastCases (x5 (0 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) || x5 x1) x5 x6;                     x4.eval (List.ofFn fun (x7 : Fin ((43 : ℕ) + (1 : ℕ))) => Fin.lastCases (x6 x2 || x6 x3) x6 x7) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x7 : Fin (42 : ℕ)) (x8 : Fin (42 : ℕ)), (↑x7 < (21 : ℕ) ∧ (21 : ℕ) ≤ ↑x8 ∧ (↑x8 + (21 : ℕ) - ↑x7) % (21 : ℕ) ∈ [(0 : ℕ), (5 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ), (17 : ℕ), (20 : ℕ)]) ∧ x5 x7 = Bool.true ∧ x5 x8 = Bool.true
plain_statement: The plane of order 4 as in the parent (points 0 to 20, lines 21 to 41, l - p mod 21 in {0, 5, 7, 17, 20} for the line wire 21 + l): for a first gate x0 OR w with w one of x1, y0, y1, and a second OR gate of two distinct earlier wires (not the first gate's own pair, and not the first gate with x0 or w), some AND/OR fan-in-at-most-two circuit of at most 122 gates reading only earlier wires, on the 42 inputs plus those two OR wires, reading every input that occurs exactly once among the four, computes incidence.
title: A step toward: Search: a circuit of fan-in-two AND/OR gates with at most 124 gates for the incidence function of the projective plane of order 4
